operator.name: Ali Ahmad
operator.note: Who runs the site and is responsible for visitor data (data controller), printed in the privacy policy and the terms' governing-law line (audit 2026-10-21 Phase 8, WL-219). Country from the owner (Pakistan-based founder, 21 Oct 2026); add a city only when the owner gives it.

reviewer.note: Technical reviewer must be a real PEC-registered electrical engineer before launch (engineer-reviewer.md). Fill name, credential (e.g. 'BSc Electrical Engineering, PEC-registered engineer'), pec_registration, same_as (LinkedIn/PEC profile) and signed_off date, then set status to signed_off. Until then no reviewer name is shown anywhere.

area_note: Organization schema areaServed and knowsLanguage (audit WL-209, 21 Oct 2026): every bill, tariff and solar default is Pakistani, and results have a Roman Urdu toggle. Set area_served null if the site goes multi-country.

analytics.note: Off (owner, 16 Oct 2026, audit WL-154): no GA tag is live, so the privacy policy prints no Analytics section. Set enabled true only once GA4 is actually installed (Google Site Kit); the privacy policy text follows this flag.

verification.note: Google Search Console HTML-tag verification (owner, 15 Oct 2026). Printed as a meta tag on the front page only (Wattlyst_Head::verification). Keep it while the property exists; removing it unverifies the property.

ads.no_ads_note: Pages that never show ads, whatever enabled says (audit 2026-10-21 Phase 8). N6: its live solar forecast uses the free Open-Meteo API, whose free tier is for non-commercial use (no ads); owner decision 21 Oct 2026: keep the free forecast and no ads on N6 rather than buy the commercial plan. The build fails if a page with a live data feed is missing here.
ads.no_ads_source: Open-Meteo terms and pricing (free API: non-commercial use; data CC BY 4.0, credit required): https://open-meteo.com/en/terms
ads.note: Stays false until AdSense approves the site (seo-rules.md 8). When approved: set adsense_pub_id (pub-...) so /ads.txt is served, create three display ad units in AdSense and put their data-ad-slot numbers in slots, then enabled true. A slot with no number prints nothing. Ads show only on tool, appliance, guide and lookup pages (max three, never near inputs or the Calculate button), never on the home page, data, embed, trust or thank-you pages. To apply: set adsense_pub_id first and keep enabled false; the front page then prints the google-adsense-account meta tag and /ads.txt is served, either of which proves ownership. enabled true also needs consent.cmp (the build fails without it, WL-217).

consent.note: Name of the Google-certified CMP once installed (seo-rules.md 8); shown in the privacy policy.

organization_same_as_note: Add brand profile URLs (YouTube, Facebook, X, LinkedIn page) to organization_same_as as each one goes live; they appear in Organization schema sameAs.

leads.note: Solar quote request form (build-plan Phase 6). Turn on only when someone answers the requests: each one is saved privately in WordPress (Solar leads menu, admins only) and emailed to contact_email. Text lives in content/lead-form.json; the privacy policy section appears only while enabled is true. Requests older than retention_days are deleted automatically. Before switching on: ask Hostinger which header carries the visitor's real IP behind their CDN and put its name in client_ip_header (null = REMOTE_ADDR), otherwise all visitors may share one hourly limit. Keep the page cache time (LiteSpeed/CDN) shorter than token_max_age_days, or cached forms carry expired tokens and real requests are refused as spam.

embed.note: Height in px of the iframe embed code on /embed-calculators/ (tools/lib/datasets.js embedList). The embed prints the result first; a calculator with an appliance list gets the taller frame so its result and first rows show without scrolling inside the frame (audit WL-238, 21 Oct 2026, measured at 390 px). The script embed resizes itself and ignores these.
